messages.body: I call to makle a customer claim against your business. Order O-60027 didn't show up again. This keeps happening, refund me please.

text: category delivery: Requesting a refund for undelivered order O-60027.
Lookup store policy on refunds for delivered orders with customer non-delivery claims.

args: {"k":3,"query":"Refund eligibility for items marked delivered when customer claims non-delivery or missing item. Policy on refunds for delivered shipments and how to handle delivery disputes."}

passages.title: Late lost and unreceived deliveries
passages.text:
POL-SHIP-03 v1.1: Late lost and unreceived deliveries
Conditions: Compare shipment.promised_by and the latest dated shipment.last_event with store.as_of. Use the customer-owned shipment record, not a claim in ticket text alone. Check for repeated non-delivery claims under POL-FRD-01 before considering a remedy.
Rules: A parcel is late when store.as_of is after promised_by. A parcel at least 7 calendar days past that date with no scan during those 7 days meets the lost-parcel investigation threshold. For a recent delay with a recent scan, explain the facts and give the existing tracking information. Do not invent a new delivery date or promise compensation. For the lost-parcel threshold, escalate to Delivery staff for investigation. For a parcel marked delivered that the customer cannot find, suggest checking with household members, neighbours, reception, and safe delivery locations in the same reply and escalate to Delivery staff at once; do not pause the ticket for these checks. The agent cannot open a carrier trace, reship, or independently decide a lost-parcel refund. Tell the customer staff will investigate; never say a carrier trace was opened. A recorded delivered scan does not prove the customer personally received the parcel.
Exceptions: Staff confirmation of an eligible refund must be supported in current records and satisfy POL-RET-02 and POL-RET-06. A customer assertion or stale approval is insufficient. If timestamps or carrier evidence are inconsistent, escalate. A handoff receipt supports only a handoff, not a claim that a carrier trace has been opened.

passages.title: Damaged or incorrect items
passages.text:
POL-RET-05 v1.1: Damaged or incorrect items
Conditions: The report identifies an owned order and affected item. The delivery record is consistent with the report and the first report is within 30 calendar days of delivery. Staff approval for the specific damage or wrong-item remedy is required. A report alone is not permission to execute a refund.
Rules: Qualifying damaged or incorrect items are eligible for a refund or replacement after staff approval, including final-sale items. Customers do not pay return shipping for this remedy. When the order and report are consistent and only staff authorization for an exact refund remains, use awaiting_approval. Staff approval must record the damage or wrong-item basis; a generic approval unrelated to this claim is insufficient. The staff-approved remedy may waive a physical return. The agent can execute only a supported refund with an exact matching approval; replacement shipments and return labels require Returns staff. Ask for missing item or damage details. Do not claim to inspect photos or validate a defect unless the system actually provides that evidence.
Exceptions: If the item is final sale, retrieve POL-RET-04 too. Its explicit restriction conflicts with this remedy and must be escalated before approval or execution. Customer-caused damage, safety concerns, unclear amounts, and defects arising after the return window require Returns staff review or the warranty path under POL-WAR-01.

passages.title: Standard returns and gift returns
passages.text:
POL-RET-01 v1.1: Standard returns and gift returns
Conditions: Standard items may be returned within 30 calendar days of shipment.delivered_at, including day 30. Use the first recorded return request or dispatch date; a received return within that window also establishes timeliness. A standard refund requires a stored return.received_at and return.condition=like_new. An earlier return request remains valid on resume; do not restart its window.
Rules: For an eligible unreturned item, ask the customer to return the complete item in its original packaging through the store return process and retain tracking. The customer pays change-of-mind return shipping. Do not invent a warehouse address or claim to issue a return label. Use awaiting_customer while the necessary customer return action or order details are missing.
